O.outcome_detail: Correlation between OSCE scores and OITE improvement

cells.quote: The authors reported a significant improvement in mean OITE scores between the two years, but no significant correlation between OITE improvement and OSCE scores.
cells.note: The study text reports no significant correlation but provides no correlation coefficient or adequate-power/equivalence evidence.

D.treatment: oral interactive feedback using elicitation and metalinguistic clues

O.outcome_detail: writing accuracy measured as errors per T-Unit in revised compositions

cells.quote: The results of the comparison of the revised compositions based on ANCOVA statistical test indicated that there was a significant difference between the scores in the OIF group (M = .26, SD = .06) and EF group (M = 1.08, SD = .06), F = 80.67, p <.05.Thus, the first null hypothesis was rejected. The magnitude of the difference (i.e., the effect size) is .63, which indicates the effectiveness of the oral interactive feedback.
cells.note: The outcome is coded as better accuracy because the OIF group had fewer errors per T-Unit than the EF group.
